errors.text_span: Испания е в синьо, Франция - в оранжево, Китай/континентален/ - в сиво, Италия - в жълто, Турция - в светло синьо, САЩ - в зелено, и Аржентина - в тъмно синьо.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly maps colors to countries. The correct mapping is: Spain (blue), France (gray), China/continental (orange), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light green), USA (green), Argentina (dark blue).

errors.text_span: Аржентина има най-високи стойности през всички години, докато САЩ имат най-ниски стойности.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Argentina has the highest values and the USA has the lowest values. The chart shows Spain with the highest values (~950 thousand hectares) and Argentina with the lowest (~200 thousand hectares).
The machine description does not explicitly state that the chart represents vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the years 2013–2022.
The machine description does not mention that the grouped bars represent comparisons between countries for each year.
The machine description does not mention that the values for all countries remain stable over the years, as indicated in the reference.
